items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the insurance law, in relation to financial guaranty insurance
single risk limits for municipal obligation bonds, special revenue bonds and
similar obligations of debt issuers in highly rated member countries of the
Organisation of Economic Co-operation and Development
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S3612

SPONSOR: BRESLIN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the insurance law, in relation to financial guaranty
insurance single risk limits for municipal obligation bonds, special
revenue bonds and similar obligations of debt issuers in highly rated
member countries of the Organisation of Economic Co-operation and Devel-
opment

 
PURPOSE:

To (i) eliminate a "ratings cliff' in the single risk limits that finan-
cial guaranty insurers may insure for municipal obligation bonds,
special revenue bonds and similar obligations of debt issuers in certain
highly rated OECD member countries, and (ii) make certain technical
corrections.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Replaces the term "securities rating agency" with the term
"nationally recognized statistical rating organization" because the
latter term is recognized and used by the U.S. Securities and Exchange
Commission and is the preferred term of the New York State Department of
Financial Services for describing credit rating agencies in New York
insurance laws and regulations.

Section 2: Corrects a typographical error.

Section 3: Expands the definition of "Governmental unit" to include a
member country of the OECD rated in the single-A (A+, A, A- or Al, A2,
A3) category by a securities rating agency acceptable to the Superinten-
dent, plus municipalities therein and political subdivisions, public
agencies and instrumentalities thereof.

Section 4: Same as Section 1.

Section 5: Same as Section 1.

Section 6: Same as Section 1.

Section 7. Creates graduated single risk limits (as a percentage of a
financial guaranty insurer's capital), for municipal obligation bonds,
special revenue bonds and similar obligations of debt issuers in OECD
member countries, based on the grade (AA- (or higher), A+, A, A- or Aa3
(or higher), A 1 , A2, A3) of the country's single-A category sovereign
rating.

Section 8. Corrects two cross-references.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The bill is necessary to facilitate the provision of financial guaranty
insurance on municipal obligation bonds, special revenue bonds and simi-
lar obligations of debt issuers in certain highly rated OECD member
countries.


The law presently features a "ratings cliff" under which the single risk
limit (measured by insured principal) for a municipal obligation bond,
special revenue bond or similar obligation of a debt issuer in an OECD
member country drops from 75% of the aggregate of the insurer's surplus
to policyholders and contingency reserves (together, "Capital") if the
OECD member country is rated double-A-minus (AA- or Aa3) to 10% of the
insurer's Capital if the OECD member country is rated single-A-plus (A+
or Al) or lower. In short, under the current law, the single risk limit
declines by 7.5 times for only a one-grade drop in the OECD member coun-
try's rating.

This "cliff' is not supported by default histories of municipal obli-
gation bonds, special revenue bonds or similar obligations.  Financial
guaranty insurers write to a zero-loss underwriting standard and this
bill would facilitate the diversification of their insured portfolios
with municipal obligation bonds, special revenue bonds and similar obli-
gations of debt issuers in highly rated OECD member countries like
Japan, Spain, and Chile.

The bill would replace the current "cliff' with a scale that preserves
the current 75% par-based single risk limit for municipal obligation
bonds, special revenue bonds and similar obligations issued by a debt
issuer in a double-A (AA+, AA, AA- or Aal, Aa2, Aa3) category-rated (or
higher) OECD member country, but adds respective 59%, 43% and 26% par-
based single risk limits for the same obligations of debt issuers in a
OECD member country rated A+ (or A 1), A (or A2) or A- (or A3).

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

None.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Relates to financial guaranty insurance single risk limits for municipal obligation bonds, special revenue bonds and similar obligations of debt issuers in highly rated member countries of the Organisation of Economic Co-operation and Development; makes certain technical corrections.
